summary.headline: Saturn in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Chapter XXXIX interprets Saturn in its own house and in the houses of Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Venus, contrasting effects in diurnal and nocturnal nativities. It discusses the ascendant, the part of fortune, wealth, health, parents, anger, labor, and status.
